description: This file contains unit tests for the HelpService class in the OrangeHRM Help plugin. It tests methods related to retrieving help configuration, processor instances, redirect URLs, and URL validation, using mock objects and simulating external HTTP responses.

classes.name: HelpServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the HelpService, testing core functionalities like retrieving configs, processors, URLs, and validation logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the HelpService instance and loads test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetHelpConfigService
methods.description: Verifies that getHelpConfigService returns an instance of HelpConfigService.

methods.name: testGetZendeskHelpProcessor
methods.description: Checks if getHelpProcessor returns an instance of ZendeskHelpProcessor.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl
methods.description: Tests getRedirectUrl method to fetch correct article URL from mocked Zendesk API response.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl2
methods.description: Ensures getRedirectUrl returns base help URL if no related article is found.

methods.name: testGetDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Validates that getDefaultRedirectUrl returns the default help URL.

methods.name: testIsValidUrl
methods.description: Checks if current help URL from config is considered valid.

methods.name: testIsValidUrl2
methods.description: Tests URL validation logic with an invalid base URL returned by getHelpConfigService.
